lanes.description: PR #564 is the production release PR (integration branch -> main). MERGING IT IS PROTECTED (owner-only: it applies migrations 127-139 to the production database and triggers the production deploy). This unit only makes the PR truthful and fully evidenced at its current head 0924c56 so the owner can decide: (1) the PR body is a 2026-10-03 handoff that predates every merge this weekend; rewrite it to the current state: the stacked PRs #572, #571, #568, #573, #574 and the main sync #597 are merged into the branch; the branch is 0 behind main and the merge into main is conflict-free; the 13 migrations 127-139 beyond main with their pinned SHA-256 values (134-139 from scripts/free-quote-ci-profile.mjs) and what each does; the independent-review and CodeRabbit evidence of each merged PR (link each PR's final summary comment); the owner actions that remain (production DB apply + readback per the apply packet, Sonar false-positive marking in the UI, Cloud Run smoke for the OVD-593 worker image, the leaked-password setting and billing-disabled proof, the shared-password rotation note) kept as an explicit owner checklist; and the statement that no production change has been made. (2) Hosted CI at 0924c56 must be green (wait for it; one re-run allowed for a known OVD-633 flake with a standing-down comment). (3) Sonar at the PR head: read the SonarCloud API for pullRequest=564 (paginate; expect many issues across 419 files); the quality gate may be red on new-code ratings; write grouped dispositions by rule and file family in the body, separating (a) issues already dispositioned in the merged PRs' bodies (cite them), (b) pre-existing issues from the recovered release source, and (c) anything new and real (fix it only if it is a real defect, in a separate small PR into the integration branch, never directly on the branch). (4) Mark the PR ready for review and request CodeRabbit (gate action; its review of a 419-file PR may be partial or rate limited; record what it produced; fix or disposition any actionable thread in a separate small PR into the integration branch). DO NOT MERGE #564.
acceptance: PR body truthful at 0924c56: merged stack, migration list 127-139 with pins, evidence links, remaining owner checklist, no production change claimed; passes scripts/validate-pr-body.mjs; no release-parent identifiers (write them in words).
